title: Farwa ka laal dilbare shabbar guzar gaya
body:
FARWA KA LAAL DILBAR-E-SHABBAR GUZARGAYA
DULHA LAHOO MEIN DOOB KE JUNGLE MEN MARGAYA
QASIM KI LAASH DEKH KE DUSHMAN BHI KEH UTHAY, LAGTA HAI JAISE CHAND ZAMEEN PAR UTAR GAYA
TUKDEY BADAN KE DEKE BACHAYA HAI DEEN KO, TERAH BARAS KE SIN MEIN BADA KAAM KAR GAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
ROTEY HUVE BAHAN SE YEH KEHNE LAGEY HUSSAIN, ZAINAB HAMARE BHAI KA DILBAR GUZAR GAYA
ROKAR HUSSAIN KEHTE THE QASIM KI LAASH PAR, SAD HAIF MAIN HOON MERA LAAL MAR GAYA
RANDH SALA PEHNEY BAITHI HAI KUCH DAIR KI DULHAN, DULHAY KA JISM DASHT-E-BALA MEIN BIKHARGAYA
JOONHI SIMTI LAFZAON MEIN DULHA KI ZAKHMI LAASH, DAMAN UROOSEY FIKAR KA ASHKAON MEIN BHAR GAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
BAKSHISH HO MERI KEHDAIN JO SHABBIR AYE RASHEED , HAR LAFZ TERE NAUHE KA DIL MEIN UTAR GAYA..
